interface.title: CurveCurator dashboard — CTRPv2 Cell viability data - 40uM Subset (dashboard_40.0.html)
interface.field: Pharmacology / chemical biology: dose-response screening (cell viability, drug-perturbation proteomics)
interface.stage_of_work: Looking at and choosing hits after a batch curve fit, once the CurveCurator pipeline has fitted a 4-parameter log-logistic model to every row and set the significance/relevance thresholds
interface.what_it_is_for: Browse 1,246 fitted dose-response curves in a self-contained Bokeh dashboard: separate real responses from noise on a volcano or potency plot, pick curves to see their raw points, fitted curve and fit statistics, and narrow the set with pEC50/signal sliders and a regex name search.

data.note: Static HTML built in advance from the bundled viability_CTRP_40 example (CTRPv2, 40 uM subset, 1,246 curves named CellLine_Compound, e.g. CML-T1_CIL70, BT416_NPC-26). Nothing is uploaded and there is no server; reloading the page resets every filter and selection (screens/019.webp).

tree.specific: Explore the CurveCurator fits of the CTRPv2 40 uM viability screen and pick out significant, relevant and potent cell line–drug curves

features.name: Volcano plot with 2D significance boundary and class filter
features.general: Scatter every item by effect size against significance, draw the decision boundary, and switch between showing all, only hits, or only non-hits; optionally swap the significance axis for a combined score
features.specific: Volcano Plot of log2 curve fold change vs -log10 p-value (curved red boundary) or Relevance Score (flat line), dots coloured by pEC50; all/regulated/not-regulated buttons hide dots on the other side of the boundary
steps: Read the dots against the red boundary
Press regulated to keep only hits, or not-regulated for the noise
Toggle p-values ↔ Relevance to change the y-axis and boundary shape
Press all to restore every dot
serves_tasks: Separate significant hits from the unaffected bulk
Switch the significance axis between a raw p-value and a combined effect-size score

features.name: Linked pick-to-detail curve viewer
features.general: Pick points on an overview scatter (click, shift-click or lasso) and see each picked item's raw measurements with its fitted model overlaid, plus its position on a distribution histogram and a row of statistics
features.specific: Tap/Shift-tap/Lasso dots on the volcano or potency plot; the Dose-Response Curve panel draws raw points and the fitted 4PL curve on a log concentration axis, the pEC50 histogram gets a red line per picked curve, and the table lists pEC50, slope, fold change, AUC, R2, relevance and signal quality
steps: Click a dot to pick one curve
Shift-click another dot to overlay a second curve
Or choose Lasso and draw around a group
Hover a curve to see its id and name
serves_tasks: Pick one item and see its raw data, fitted model and statistics
Add a second item to compare overlaid curves
Pick a group of items by drawing around them
Tell a noise item or a borderline item apart from a real response

features.name: Volcano / potency view switch
features.general: Switch the overview scatter from a significance view to a potency view that defaults to significant items only, then switch back
features.specific: Top dropdown Volcano ↔ Potency; Potency plots pEC50 vs log2 fold change with vertical fold-change thresholds, forces the class toggle to regulated and hides the p-values/Relevance toggle; the current selection is kept
steps: Choose Potency in the dropdown
Compare pEC50 of the significant dots (selected ones stay highlighted)
Optionally press all to see non-significant curves
Choose Volcano to go back
serves_tasks: Plot potency for significant items only

features.name: Range-slider filters linked to marginal histograms
features.general: Drag the two handles of a range slider to keep items whose value falls in a window; the window bounds appear as dashed lines on that variable's histogram and items outside it vanish from the scatter
features.specific: pEC50 Range Selection (0.40–12.90) and Signal Range Selection (0–2) sliders; dashed lines on the pEC50 and Signal histograms; filtered dots disappear from the volcano/potency plot
steps: Drag the lower handle
Drag the upper handle
Check the dashed bounds on the histogram
Lasso or search within what is left
serves_tasks: Restrict items to a potency window

features.name: Regex name search into selection
features.general: Pick all items whose name matches a regular expression, case-sensitive or not, and send them to the linked detail views
features.specific: Name text box + Select Name button + case-sensitive search checkbox; matches among the curves shown by the class toggle become the selection (curve panel, histograms, table)
steps: Type a pattern such as ^(A549|HCT-15|MCF7)_
Press Select Name
Untick case-sensitive search for a case-insensitive match
Change the class toggle and search again to widen or narrow the set
serves_tasks: Pick items by a name pattern

features.name: Sortable selection table with row drill-down
features.general: List the picked items with their fit statistics, sort by any column, and click a row to narrow the selection to that one item
features.specific: Bokeh DataTable (#, Name, Curve pEC50 [M], Slope, Fold Change, AUC, R2, Relevance, Signal Quality); click a header to sort ascending, click again for descending; clicking a row reduces the selection to that curve in every panel
steps: Pick curves on the plot or by search
Click a column header to sort
Click again to reverse the order
Click a row to focus on that curve
serves_tasks: Rank and narrow the picked items in the results table
Tell a noise item or a borderline item apart from a real response

features.name: Plot navigation toolbar (zoom, pan, undo, reset, hover, save)
features.general: Zoom into a box, pan, step back, reset the view, switch tooltips on or off, and export the plot as PNG
features.specific: Bokeh toolbar on the Volcano/Potency plot: Box Zoom, Pan, Undo, Reset, Hover toggle, Save (bokeh_plot.png after a filename prompt)
steps: Choose Box Zoom and drag a box
Choose Pan and drag
Press Undo to step back
Press Reset to restore the full view
Toggle Hover to hide tooltips
Press Save to download a PNG
serves_tasks: Zoom and pan into a crowded part of the plot
Save the current plot as an image

features.name: Linked marginal-histogram markers
features.general: Show where picked items and the current filter window sit on each variable's distribution: one line per picked item, dashed lines for the window bounds
features.specific: pEC50 histogram draws a red line at each picked curve's pEC50; the pEC50 and Signal histograms draw dashed lines at the Range Selection slider bounds
steps: Pick one or more curves on the plot
Read the red line(s) on the pEC50 histogram
Move a range slider
Read the dashed bounds on that histogram
serves_tasks: Pick one item and see its raw data, fitted model and statistics
Restrict items to a potency window

screens_never_reached: A 'Score' slider (mentioned in the goals): this dashboard has only pEC50 and Signal range sliders
not_done: Fitting curves, setting thresholds, or loading a different TOML/raw data file: the page is a static, pre-built dashboard with no upload or pipeline controls

Reading explicit up/down/not regulation categories in the table: the table shows no regulation-class column, only Relevance, so a curve's class has to be worked out from the class toggle or by comparing Relevance with the red threshold line (about 1.3) on the Relevance volcano
Exporting the table or the selected rows: there is no download control for curves.txt or for the selection, only PNG plot saves
Seeing the slider filters update the selection: after a Signal or pEC50 filter change, curves already picked stayed in the curve panel and table even when their dots were hidden (screens/018.webp)
A histogram hover tooltip: the pEC50 histogram's ⋮ menu offers a hover tool (screens/031.webp), but hovering a bar showed no tooltip (screens/032.webp)
Confirming that the second Save, from the dose-response panel, wrote a separate file: the downloads list still showed only one bokeh_plot.png, possibly overwritten, and no screen shows that save
The lasso was only drawn as a straight drag (the browser can't trace a freehand loop), so it picked the dots along that line rather than a filled region

Whether Reset clears the selection: after Reset (screens/023.webp) the table was empty but a flat curve was still drawn in the Dose-Response panel, and the replay had nothing selected when it pressed Reset
Removing items from a selection: the README describes ESC on the plot to deselect and Ctrl-click on a table row to deselect only that row; neither was tried
A per-curve marker on the Signal histogram: no kept screen shows one, and the replay saw no clear mark (the picked curves may have had signal 0)
Whether the name search also respects the pEC50/Signal slider filters, and whether Enter triggers Select Name: neither was tested
